title: Journey to the Moon
synopsis: A rival's bet, a cannon half a mile long, and a crew of four with one small robot. A retelling of Jules Verne's tale of the first voyage to the Moon, with a rotating Earth, falling stars and a face in the craters.
credit: After Jules Verne (public domain). Original script.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: For as long as people have looked up, the Moon has looked back. Silver, silent, and just far enough away to seem impossible.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: After a long war, the engineers of the Baltimore Gun Club had nothing left to build. Their president, Impey Barbicane, called them together with a plan so large it frightened even them.

scenes.speaker: barbicane
scenes.text: Gentlemen, we will build a cannon half a mile long, sunk into the ground. And we will fire a shell at the Moon. With people inside.

scenes.speaker: nicholl
scenes.text: Impossible. I make armour. I know what metal can bear, and no shell can survive a gun like that. I will bet you three thousand dollars it cracks.

scenes.speaker: barbicane
scenes.text: Then I will take that bet, Captain, and I will win it from the other side of the sky. Come and watch me dig the hole.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: They dug for a year in the sands of Florida. A shaft as deep as a mountain, lined with iron, and a shell of polished metal waiting beside it, bright as a coin.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Then a boat arrived with a stranger from Paris, who leapt out onto the dock before it had even stopped, and began to run.

scenes.speaker: ardan
scenes.text: Make room, my friends! I heard that you are building a ship for the Moon, and I refuse to be left behind. Michel Ardan, at your service. One passenger. Very curious.

scenes.speaker: nicholl
scenes.text: You are mad. The journey will take four days with no air but what we carry. There is no way home but through a cannon in reverse.

scenes.speaker: ardan
scenes.text: Captain, a man who does not believe in the impossible has never really tried to live. Besides, I brought tobacco and cheese. What else does a person need?

scenes.speaker: barbicane
scenes.text: He is right about one thing. This is not a trip for soldiers alone. We need a doctor, someone who understands the body in the dark between worlds.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Then I am your doctor. Ada Laurent. I have studied how bodies fail in the cold and the quiet. I do not intend to let any of you do it.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: They climbed into the shell, one by one, and sealed the hatch. Four people, one small robot called Diana, a library, and a crate of tobacco and cheese.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The countdown began. Above the sand, the whole world held its breath, and the great gun pointed at the sky.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The gun fired, and the sound was heard on every shore. For one moment the shell was a streak of fire, and then it was silence, and then it was the stars.

scenes.speaker: ardan
scenes.text: Is everyone alive? I think I am alive. I have never felt so light. Doctor, are my feet on the floor, or is the floor on my feet?

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Hold on to something, Michel, and breathe slowly. Your body has nothing to push against. Diana, stay close to the hatch, please.

scenes.speaker: nicholl
scenes.text: I owe Barbicane three thousand dollars. The shell did not crack. I have never been so pleased to lose a bet.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Then the window flared red. A shower of meteors was racing past the shell, tiny stones moving faster than any bullet, and every one of them aimed at the crew.

scenes.speaker: barbicane
scenes.text: Everyone down! Keep clear of the glass. Nicholl, the shutters, now! If we hold our course, the Moon will catch us before the stones can.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The stones passed. In the window, the Earth turned slowly, blue and small, and beyond it the Moon grew until it filled the sky.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The shell touched down so softly that the crew hardly felt it. Outside, the sky was black at noon, and the ground was the colour of ash.

scenes.speaker: ardan
scenes.text: I will go first. I am the one who ate the cheese, so I have earned it. A small step for a man, a giant leap for his reputation.

scenes.speaker: ada
scenes.text: Wait, Michel. Look at the footprints, they do not blow away. And listen. There is no wind, no sound at all. This world has been waiting for us.

scenes.speaker: moonface
scenes.text: Welcome, small travellers. I am the face you have drawn in my craters for ten thousand years. You are the first to answer, and I am glad.

scenes.speaker: barbicane
scenes.text: We came to touch you, and we have. But we left a world behind us that is waiting to hear that this was possible. May we go home?

scenes.speaker: moonface
scenes.text: Go, and tell them that the Moon is not a wall but a door. Others will come. Look up tonight, and I will wave back.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The shell fell home and splashed down in a warm blue sea, and the people who looked up that night saw the Moon in a different way, as a place with footprints in it.
